searchText: Another question about attestors. Let’s say 95% of attestors voted for a block in slot 3 and 5% voted for the previous block because they missed it. But for some reason the block producer in slot 4 goes with the 5%. Assuming perfect information from this point, what is the default action for attestors in slot 4. Do they vote for the new slot 4 block or the slot 3 block? https://github.com/ethereum/annotated-spec/blob/master/phase0/fork-choice.md > The core idea of LMD GHOST is that at each fork, instead of choosing the side that contains a longer chain, we choose the side that has more total support from validators, counting only the most recent message of each validator as support. So they vote for slot 3? With the information you are giving now yes, but it depends on what happened before or on other forks: weight is counted since the last finalized checkpoint I assume 100% perfect agreement before that point

Another question about attestors.

Let’s say 95% of attestors voted for a block in slot 3 and 5% voted for the previous block because they missed it. But for some reason the block producer in slot 4 goes with the 5%.

Assuming perfect information from this point, what is the default action for attestors in slot 4. Do they vote for the new slot 4 block or the slot 3 block?

excerpts.author: pietjepuk
excerpts.content:
https://github.com/ethereum/annotated-spec/blob/master/phase0/fork-choice.md

> The core idea of LMD GHOST is that at each fork, instead of choosing the side that contains a longer chain, we choose the side that has more total support from validators, counting only the most recent message of each validator as support.
